repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a 1-minute sustained wait for `Presence == false` before acting. The candidate used a 1000 ms wrapper with a threshold of 60, causing the action to fire at 60 seconds (59000 ms) instead of 60 seconds (60000 ms). With a 1000 ms period, the first tick counts at t=0, so the action triggers after 59 full periods (59000 ms). The IR requires the action at exactly 60 seconds (60000 ms), which corresponds to the 61st tick (hold=61).
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period to 100 ms to allow fine-grained counting. Updated the threshold from 60 to 61 so that the action fires exactly when the condition has been true for 60 complete 100 ms intervals (plus the initial t=0 tick), matching the 1-minute IR duration.
